evidence: All five prompt.md files plus tests/app_context.md describe this app only. app_context.md:3 names 'Kittle & Rowe matter chat'; :10-16 lists exactly the five seed accounts (harriet/dev/sian/gwen/paul@kittle.test, password123) with roles and scopes that match seed_data.json (Gwen client of M-11 and M-13, Paul of M-12, M-12 walled=[dev]); key screens (:20) match the brief's surfaces. Every prompt's gate account is gwen@kittle.test; functional prompt's restart section names restart_app on server 'verifier', matching judge.toml mcp_servers and restart_mcp.py:14; 'each session grades one criterion' matches mode='individual'; visual prompt:49 scope (M-11, M-13 nested replies, M-11 transcript, 1440x900 and 390x844) matches its four criteria. I cross-checked every seed entity named in the criteria against seed_data.json: titles (Pryce lease dispute / Marsh Holdings acquisition / Pryce will), message texts K-1,K-2(+'Landlords notice recieved.'),K-3,K-6,K-8,K-10,K-11,K-13(+'2,400'),K-14,K-15,K-16,K-17,K-18,K-7, timestamps (Boundary note exactly 7 days, K-11 one second younger, Costs estimate 9 days, probate 8 days, Survey 2026-05-08 15:00), hold flags, timer values (M-11 7, M-12 off, M-13 30), and @-suggestion sets per matter (M-12: Harriet/Sian/Paul; M-11: all but Paul). All consistent; no foreign product name, account list or data shape found (grep for channel/workspace/ticket/cart/board/project/room/other emails/ids: only template boilerplate 'empty workspace' in the frozen gate wording, which is template-controlled and generic). Reported instances (every one found, none residue from a sibling task, grep shows the names exist only in kittle copies): (1) tests/scored/polish/judge.toml:57-58 id/name 'transcript_print' while the description grades 390x844 no-sideways-scroll, not printing; the frozen golden script itself calls it polish_transcript_phone (raw-evidence-index.json). (2) tests/scored/visual/judge.toml:69-70 id 'phone_chambers' uses 'chambers', which is not this firm's vocabulary (description is accurate: 'Gwen's matter thread at 390 by 844'). (3) tests/app_context.md:30 'The library of messages grows' is odd wording but correct in meaning. Descriptions are explicit, so a judge following them grades correctly; impact is latent only. Adversarial check: a broken app cannot exploit these labels (the criterion text, not the id, defines steps); a conforming app (matter list on its own screen, any timer label, any time format) is accommodated by the prompts. No configured judge run exists to show how the judge reads the ids, so run evidence is NOT EXERCISED.
